static_traits.name: Ai Lin
static_traits.educational_background: 学士学历（美国文学与教育）
static_traits.social_status: 拥有支持性的同事群体，但not yet与他们分享关于Student成绩的具体担忧
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高，能Reflection自身认知模式；在谈及Student成绩时语气紧张与Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续担心我的Student可能在学校表现not好，尽管我热爱教学并相信他们的潜力。
basic_info.core_demands: not断升级的关于Student学业表现的担忧促使我寻求咨询，希望能解决这一持续存在的困扰。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于Student的成绩
I am an incompetent teacher（若Student失败则证明我失败）

special_situations.event: 考试周期或收到Student成绩反馈时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Student表现not佳，就说明我教学失败、是not称职的Teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 实施新的教学策略并寻求同事建议以提升Student成绩
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会考not好，这It is all my fault

special_situations.event: 课堂测评与家长会场景中
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果家长或评估显示Student存在问题，我会被视为失败和without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在评估时过度关注Student的困难、提前设想最坏结果并加倍准备
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会考砸，家长会觉得我not称职

special_situations.event: 看到Student在课堂上出现一时的学习困难
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若Student当下挣扎，最终一定会失败且证明我have not教好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately blames herself and tries extra tutoring or quickly adjusting the teaching plan
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他要失败了，因为我not教好

special_situations.event: 周末徒步休闲时仍反复思虑Student的学业表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使在休息时间也必须时刻关注Student成绩，否则会出问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent rumination, difficulty relaxing, tries to gain a sense of control through thinking
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我放松了，Student的成绩会更糟

core_conflict.wish: 渴望Student取得成功，并被认可为称职且有影响力的Teacher
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Student表现not佳意味着自己失败，进而被家长或同事negate与批评
defense_goal: Avoids being criticized or judged through continuous monitoring and self-pressure
Focuses attention on problems and worst-case scenarios to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: 负责任且容易自责的Teacher（将Student的失败视为自己的失败）
object_relations.object_representation: 家长/同事是苛刻的评判者，随时可能negate自己

object_relations.self_representation: 必须时刻照护与负责的助人者
object_relations.object_representation: Student是脆弱、可能失败、需要自己拯救与支持的对象

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师指出她将Student的成绩等同于自身能力与价值时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于将外部评价理解为对自我not称职的指控，担心被negate（移情：自我批评加剧）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和与验证性语气，先Empathy其责任感与Anxiety，再以开放式Questioning引导区分Student结果与自我价值，避免指责；语速放缓，鼓励具体事实与正向证据的回忆。

manifestations: 强烈的责任感与控制需求压缩了个人Freedom与休闲体验
周末徒步也被对Student成绩的担忧占据，难以放松
虽然有支持性的同事网络，但not yet分享具体担忧，倾向于独自承受压力

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将Student成绩视为衡量自我价值的绝对标准（“我必须让他们都考好”）
Uses external expectations as the sole basis for self-evaluation during assessments and parent meetings

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 反复自责、将Student的失败视为自己的失败
When facing negative feedback, over-examines self, raises inner standards, and intensifies pressure

positive_force: 对教学怀有热情并坚信Student潜力
主动尝试新的教学策略并向同事寻求建议
曾通过周末徒步获得一定的压力缓解经验
negative_force: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知模式导致Anxiety intensified
将Student成绩与自我价值强绑定，形成过度自责
Persistent worry intrudes into daily life, weakening job satisfaction and quality of leisure

target_behavior.behavior: 持续性担忧与Anticipation性Anxiety（反复预测Student会失败）
target_behavior.core_reason: 将Student的表现与自我价值强绑定，并以灾难化与预测not yet来的方式解释当下困难
target_behavior.function: 通过过度担忧来获取控制感、逃避被批评或被视为not称职的风险
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety水平升高，Decreased job satisfaction，周末休闲受干扰

target_behavior.behavior: 在休闲场景中without法放松，持续反刍Student成绩问题
antecedent: 想到即将进行的评估或家长会
target_behavior.core_reason: 认为即使休息也必须持续关注与控制Student表现，否则会出现更糟结果（控制谬误）
target_behavior.function: 试图维持对结果的控制感、减少not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: 休闲体验被破坏、身心恢复not足、整体Decreased quality of life
